WITH revenue_2024 AS (SELECT r.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06') GROUP BY r.id), revenue_2025 AS (SELECT r.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06') GROUP BY r.id) SELECT r.name FROM revenue_2024 r24 JOIN revenue_2025 r25 ON r24.id = r25.id JOIN regions r ON r.id = r24.id ORDER BY (r25.revenue - r24.revenue) / r24.revenue LIMIT 1

WITH avg_resolution AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_res FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg_resolution AS (SELECT c.id, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_res FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets st ON st.customer_id = c.id WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(st.id) > 0) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_avg_resolution car JOIN (SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2) co ON co.id = car.id WHERE car.avg_res > (SELECT avg_res FROM avg_resolution)

WITH avg_resolution AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_time FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg_resolution AS (SELECT c.id, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_time FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets st ON st.customer_id = c.id WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(st.id) > 0) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_avg_resolution car JOIN (SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 6) co ON co.id = car.id WHERE car.avg_time > (SELECT avg_time FROM avg_resolution)

WITH revenue_by_region AS (SELECT r.id, r.name, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id, year) SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, (revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) / revenue_2024 * 100 AS growth FROM (SELECT r.name, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2025' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025 FROM revenue_by_region r GROUP BY r.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) > 0) ORDER BY growth DESC, name LIMIT 1)
